name: Gästehaus Gruber
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Gruber is located in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser and offers holiday apartments. The quiet location in the village means shops are within easy reach. The surrounding mountain landscape is ideal for active holidaymakers in summer and winter. The holiday apartments are modernly furnished and have a fully equipped kitchen. Guests can relax on the balcony or terrace. The general atmosphere is characterized by hospitality and tranquillity. Hiking trails and the ski lift are nearby.
